policy.coordinate: decode each stored coordinate as f32, multiply by f32 10000 with an f32 result, then round the f32 product half away from zero to signed i32
policy.weld: linear first-match scan in source order by exact quantized xyz
policy.degenerate: duplicate vertex or zero projected XY signed area
policy.orientation: positive Z; swap vertices 1 and 2 when negative
policy.manifold: for each directed face edge, linearly compare every undirected face edge and reject incidence above two before and after collapse
policy.volume: sum the signed six-times-volume determinant over every simplified face in canonical order; the generated planar open fixture must equal exactly zero and makes no watertight-volume claim
policy.simplification: collapse each odd quantized X column onto the preceding even X column, linearly weld by first match, remap every face in source order, then remove collapsed faces
policy.serialization: 20 little-endian i32 header words, simplified quantized xyz, then selected face indices

work.comparisonUnit: one candidate xyz tuple or undirected edge tested by the prescribed linear scan
work.allocationUnit: one explicit JavaScript DataView, Array, typed array, or output view allocated by the repair operation; Wasm uses fixed static storage and reports zero operative allocations
